Anjan’s celebrates Victory Day
2019-12-10T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/news/anjans-celebrates-victory-day-1837780

Keeping in mind the importance of 16 December and paying homage to the heritage and pride in indigenous designs, Anjan’s introduces its latest collection that pays respect to Victory Day.

This year’s designs include collages of stories and paintings depicting the Liberation war and the national flower, the water lily.

With the two integral colours of the flag; red and green, their collection includes saris, panjabis, tops, shalwar kameezs and t-shirts. For children, there is also a very similar line, including frocks as well, all available at your nearest Anjan’s outlet.

For more information, visit www.facebook.com/anjans.bd
